title: RehearsalBench: Can AI Predict What Happens When You Change a Company?
abstract: arXiv:2611.22480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizations increasingly ask AI systems what will happen if they change how they operate: which work to automate, which team to resize, what a voice agent will do to waiting times. We introduce RehearsalBench, a benchmark that measures whether AI models can diagnose an operation, choose an intervention, and forecast its consequences. Each model is placed in a simulated bank contact center fitted to real call-level records, sees only what a manager would see, and submits a plan and forecasts that are then played out across 200 seeded futures and three plausible versions of the organization. Decisions are scored in dollars at the stakeholders' stated valuations; forecasts are scored on the effect of each change relative to doing nothing. Ten models made 280 attempts across 14 organizations. translated_title: RehearsalBench：AI能预测改变一家公司后会发生什么吗？
translated_abstract: 组织越来越频繁地向AI系统询问：如果改变运营方式会发生什么——哪些工作应该自动化、哪个团队需要调整规模、语音客服会对等待时间产生什么影响。我们提出了RehearsalBench，这是一个衡量AI模型能否诊断运营状况、选择干预措施并预测其后果的基准测试。每个模型被置于一个基于真实通话级记录构建的模拟银行联络中心中，只能看到管理者所能看到的信息，并提交计划和预测，这些计划和预测随后在200个种子化未来情景和三个合理版本的组织中推演。决策按照利益相关者声明的估值以美元计分；预测则根据每项变革相对于维持现状（不采取行动）的效果进行评分。十个模型在14个组织中共进行了280次尝试。表现最好的模型GPT-6 Astra在不采取任何行动的基础上将成本改善了相当于无变化成本6.8%的幅度，其预测误差比一个总是预测“不进行任何变革”的预测者低77%（原摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了RehearsalBench基准，在基于真实通话记录的模拟银行联络中心中评估AI模型诊断运营、选择干预措施并预测组织变革后果的能力，最优模型GPT-6 Astra相比不作为可降低6.8%的成本，且预测误差减少77%。
en_tdlr: RehearsalBench is a benchmark evaluating whether AI models can diagnose operations, choose interventions, and forecast the consequences of organizational changes in a simulated bank contact center built on real call-level records, with the best model (GPT-6 Astra) improving cost by 6.8% over doing nothing and reducing forecast error by 77%.
